screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf: You are not yet a werewolf.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.bite: A bite from a wild wolf or werewolf may slip the curse into your veins. Endure the night, and when darkness returns, you will hear your own howl.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.infe: The bite still burns; the curse has already taken root in your blood. Come nightfall, you will hear yourself howl.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.poti: Rather not wait? Drink a Werewolf Potion and join the pack tonight. Welcome, werewolf brother.
screen.howlingwerewolf.kill_xp_rule: Kill XP scaling: 50% of the target's max HP (raised up to 75% with Hunting Mastery).
skill.howlingwerewolf.damage.desc: Each rank increases claw damage by 30%.
skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.
skill.howlingwerewolf.resistance.desc: Ranks 1–3 clear Weakness, Poison, and Slowness; rank 4 adds Mining Fatigue and Blindness; rank 5 adds Wither and Darkness.
skill.howlingwerewolf.regeneration.desc: Heals 0.5 HP per rank every 2.5s while transformed.
message.howlingwerewolf.infected: A fever pulses outward from the fresh bite...
message.howlingwerewolf.awakened: Night settles over the world. The wolf buried beneath the wound opens its eyes, and strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.full_moon: The full moon hangs high. An ancient covenant drags you into wolf form, and feral strength awakens with it.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_sets: Dawn severs the moon's reins. You reclaim your human shape, but the beast's aftershock leaves your limbs heavy.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_forced: The full moon holds absolute domain over your blood; tonight, there is no road back to human form.
message.howlingwerewolf.werewolf_on: Bones crack and reshape beneath a low snarl; dormant claws break through flesh as wild strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.human_on: Claws recede beneath your skin as fury fades; the exhaustion of the beast leaves limbs heavy and hands unsteady.
message.howlingwerewolf.cured: The wolfsbane scours the curse from your veins, and the wild fever falls silent.
message.howlingwerewolf.potion_awakened: The draught burns through your veins, waking the wolf within your bones with a surge of newborn strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_unavailabl: Progression reset requires werewolf level 6 or higher.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_success: Progression reset complete. Level %s; skill points %s; skill-tree points %s.
item.howlingwerewolf.alpha_werewolf_badg: Active while carried anywhere in the hotbar
Werewolf blood: grants 10 base werewolf XP per minute
Werewolf form: blocks one fatal blow (configurable to keep the badge)
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.full_moon: Full moons trigger a forced transformation. While in werewolf form, you gain a temporary Strength buff; however, reverting to human form inflicts negative penalties such as Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.armor: Unlocking Armored Instinct allows bipedal werewolves to equip armor and elytra. Each piece that provides an armor value reduces your werewolf natural damage reduction by 25% and cuts your speed and jump bonuses by 17.5% (zero-armor gear like elytra is exempt). Quadruped and Beast forms still cannot wear equipment.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.fire: While transformed, you take 50% more fire damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.night_vision: After unlocking the Night Vision skill, transforming grants you active Night Vision.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.diet: While transformed, your diet is strictly carnivorous until you unlock the Hard Life skill, which allows normal eating.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.silver: Werewolves take 50% bonus damage from Silver Sword attacks and suffer Weakness II.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.progression: Earn experience by slaying targets to level up, advance down the skill tree, and learn new abilities.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.level_scalin: Each level-up permanently scales up your base damage and natural damage reduction.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.quadruped: Quadruped Wolf: unlocked by learning the Wildstride Form skill. Significantly boosts movement speed and jump height at the cost of a slight drop in attack damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast: Alpha Beast Form: grants massive bonuses to attack damage, movement speed, jumping height, and natural armor, balanced by a noticeably higher hunger drain rate.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast_warnin: Balance Warning: This endgame form packs extreme combat stats and may impact gameplay balance.

screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.title: Trial of the Alpha's Moon-Crown
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.locked: Beast Form: Moon-Crown trial not yet conquered
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.unlocked: Beast Form: Unlocked (press H to shift)
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.intro: Set up five altars according to the diagram below to initiate the rite, defeating waves of Silver-Oath Watchers followed by the Moon-Crowned Alpha boss. Your first clear permanently unlocks the ultimate Beast Form (press H). Repeat clears: Easy/Normal difficulty guarantees 1 Moonbane Pearl back; Hard difficulty awards 1 bonus Skill Point, 1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 pearls (the primary way to farm extra progression points at max level).
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.layout: Altar Layout (top-down view): Altar 1 is the central altar; Altars 2–5 are regular outer altars spaced 3 blocks away from the center (gray squares represent the 2 intervening empty blocks). All five altars must be placed at the exact same Y level.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.items: Ritual Offerings: Place 1 Alpha Werewolf Badge on the central altar and 1 Moonbane Pearl on each of the 4 outer altars. All 4 pearls are consumed immediately upon starting; winning consumes the badge, while defeat drops the badge safely beside the central altar for retrieval.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.requirement: Prerequisites: Must be initiated at night in the Overworld by a player at werewolf level 10+ in standard bipedal wolf form. No other players may be present within the 18-block arena ward.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.warning: Failure Conditions: Dying, disconnecting, leaving the arena, breaking an altar block, or switching to Peaceful mode results in immediate failure and dispels the ward. The boundary barrier violently knocks back anyone who touches it.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.i: There are two paths to lycanthropy: contracting an infection from wild wolf attacks, or drinking a Werewolf Potion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.b: Attacks from wild wolves have a 10% chance to infect you, while Feral Werewolves carry a 20% infection rate (configurable). Once contracted, the infection incubates quietly until you awaken on a later night.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.p: If you prefer not to wait out the incubation period, brew and drink a Werewolf Potion to unlock your werewolf powers immediately.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.f: Feral Werewolves only spawn during full moons, requiring an Overworld forest biome and sufficiently dark conditions.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.c: To cure your lycanthropy and revert permanently to human form, drink a Wolfsbane Potion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.transform.i: Once awakened, press J to shift back and forth between human form and bipedal werewolf form.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.transform.k: Keybinds: K opens the Ability menu, Z aims and activates Feral Leap, V toggles automatic Night Vision, N casts Wolf Spirits, B executes Bloody Bite, R triggers Moonblood Surge, and C brings up Companions. All hotkeys can be rebound in the Controls menu.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.traits.intr: Lycanthropy delivers immense physical advantages and combat bonuses, accompanied by specific restrictions and vulnerabilities.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.traits.hunt: Hunters stay neutral toward normal humans, but actively hunt down transformed players and  werewolves. Village patrols consist of 4–6 Hunters. Hunters cannot spawn within 48 blocks of any tribe building.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.poin: Leveling up awards both Skill-tree Points and Skill Points: allocate points on the Skill Tree page to buff core attributes, and unlock active/passive skills on the Skills page.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.badg: Keep an Alpha Werewolf Badge in your hotbar: as long as you carry werewolf blood, you passively gain 10 base werewolf XP per minute—even while in human form.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.quadruped.k: Once learned, press G while transformed to toggle between bipedal and quadruped wolf forms. The quadruped cannot equip armor and carries whatever is held in the main hand in its mouth.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.beast.title: Beast Form
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.beast.key: Unlocked by your first victory in the Alpha Trial. Press H while transformed to shift between standard werewolf and Beast form; Beast Form cannot equip armor.
Offer a Moonbane Pearl and Wolfsbane flowers across the five Moon-Oath Altars to summon a wandering werewolf brother ready for barter.

Summoning Steps: Place 1 Moonbane Pearl on the center altar and 1 Wolfsbane on each of the 4 outer altars, then right-click the center altar empty-handed. The 4 flowers are consumed, while the pearl remains in place to be reclaimed or reused.
Right-click the merchant to trade. Once you have learned the Pack Oath skill, right-click him while holding an Alpha Werewolf Badge and confirm to recruit him as a permanent companion.

Press C to open the Companion menu. Issue orders like Follow, Guard, Rest, Sort containers, or go Hunting; you can also perform cross-dimensional recalls, tier promotions, revivals, renaming, and fur coat customization.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.items.title: Items & Recipes
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.items.intro: Click on any item icon to inspect its stats, sources, and crafting recipes.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.wolfsb: Naturally spawns in taiga biomes, and less commonly in forests, birch forests, and dark forests. Slain Hunters are guaranteed to drop at least one, making them the most reliable source. Essential for brewing Wolfsbane Potions, crafting Moonbane Pearls, Moon-Oath Altars, and Alpha Werewolf Badges, as well as summoning werewolf merchants.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.silver: Spawns underground throughout the Overworld, including deepslate variants. Smelt it in a standard furnace or blast furnace to extract Silver Ingots.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.deepsl: Deepslate variant of silver ore found at deeper levels. Can be smelted into Silver Ingots using a furnace or blast furnace.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.silver: Obtained by smelting silver ores, with a small drop chance from Hunters. Key crafting material for Silver Swords and Alpha Werewolf Badges.
The ultimate werewolf counter: deals 50% bonus damage to werewolves and inflicts Weakness II. The signature blade carried by patrol Hunters.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.wolfsb: Brewed by adding Wolfsbane into an Awkward Potion at a brewing stand. Restores a werewolf to normal human form; non-werewolves who drink it suffer Poison II for 60 seconds.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.werewo: Brewed by adding a Fermented Spider Eye into a Wolfsbane Potion at a brewing stand. Drinking it instantly infects a human, triggers immediate werewolf awakening, and grants a brief Strength buff.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.moonba: Crafted from 1 Ender Pearl and 4 Wolfsbane flowers. Essential for initiating the Alpha Trial, summoning werewolf merchants, crafting Alpha Werewolf Badges, and promoting companion tiers.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.alpha_: Crafted by placing a Moonbane Pearl in the center surrounded by 4 Silver Ingots and 4 Wolfsbane. Kept in the hotbar, it passively awards 10 base werewolf XP per minute to werewolf players and absorbs one fatal blow while transformed. Also used to trigger the Alpha Trial, as well as recruit and revive companions.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.ritual: Crafted with 8 Stone Bricks surrounding 1 Wolfsbane. Four of these are required for the Alpha Trial and merchant summoning, placed 3 blocks north, south, east, and west of the central altar.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.centra: Crafted from 1 Moon-Oath Altar, 4 Gold Blocks, and 4 Diamonds. Stands in the center of the five-altar formation; once offerings are placed, right-click it empty-handed to trigger the ritual.

tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.moon_rend.des: Each rank adds bonus claw damage equal to 0.6% of the target's max HP.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.

tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.jump.desc: Each rank adds 1.2 blocks of jump height.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.knockback_res: Each rank grants 50% knockback resistance; maximum rank fully prevents knockback.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.fall_resistan: Rank 1 cuts fall damage by 50%; rank 2 grants full immunity to fall damage.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.lifesteal.des: Heals for 10% / 15% / 20% of final melee damage dealt, up to max HP.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.satiety.desc: Lowers transformed hunger drain from 1.5x down to 1.33x, 1.16x, and 1.0x.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.claw_efficien: Each rank extends empty-claw reach and adds a level of Looting to claw kills.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.hunting_maste: Kill XP becomes 60%, then 75%, of the victim's maximum health.
ability.howlingwerewolf.summon_wolf_spir: Press N to summon 5 Wolf Spirits that follow and fight alongside you for 4 minutes. Cooldown: 60s.
ability.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_form.d: Press G while transformed to switch between bipedal and quadruped wolf form. Greatly boosts speed and jump height at a slight loss in attack damage. Cannot wear equipment.
Press R while transformed to activate, granting strong regeneration, absorption, decaying Resistance, and combat buffs. Recruited companions within 16 blocks in the same dimension share both the effect and the crash (recalling preserves remaining time). Cooldown: 4m. The Resistance skill clears the penalties.
ability.howlingwerewolf.armored_instinct: Lets bipedal werewolves wear armor and elytra. Each piece with armor value reduces natural damage reduction by 25% and werewolf speed/jump bonuses by 17.5%; zero-armor gear is exempt.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.desc: Permanently unlocked after your first Alpha victory; press H to toggle. Beast Form cannot wear equipment.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.warni: Only one who tears the Moon-Crown from its bearer may wake the beast buried deepest in the blood.
ability.howlingwerewolf.hard_life.desc: Lifts the meat-only restriction, letting you eat bread, produce, and other non-meat foods while transformed.
Keeps one hotbar slot empty; picked-up items go to your inventory or other hotbar slots and cannot be picked up once those are full.
ability.howlingwerewolf.long_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks deal 50% damage to nearby enemies.
ability.howlingwerewolf.tool_claws.desc: While transformed, empty-hand mining treats your claws as an iron pickaxe, axe, and shovel, matching iron harvest tiers and speed.
ability.howlingwerewolf.fire_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks while transformed inflict Fire Aspect II.
ability.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite.desc: Press B while transformed and empty-handed to bite your target for 1.8x current claw damage, inflicting Weakness II, Slowness III, Hunger, and Poison for 15s. Cooldown: 60s.
message.howlingwerewolf.meat_only: A true beast scorns bland vegetarian fare.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_on: The last chain of reason snaps. An ancient beast tears its way through flesh and bone.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_off: The primeval fury ebbs; dreadful fangs withdraw as the colossal frame settles back into wolf form.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_locked: The beast buried deepest in your blood still slumbers. Claim the Moon-Crown in the Alpha Trial first.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_on: Your spine lowers to the soil; four paws strike an ancient cadence as the open wild becomes your hunting ground.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_off: Forepaws lift from the dust as you rise upright upon two legs; the breath of the chase still echoes in your chest.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_on: Moonblood boils within your heart. Wounds close, and a silver tide floods every bone with strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.full_moon_no_sle: The full moon burns in your blood. You cannot sleep tonight.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_cooldo: The fury in your veins has yet to settle; the moonblood tide will answer again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_crash: The borrowed tide of moonfire dies away; cold exhaustion and crushing weight drag down your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.spirit_cooldown: Wolf spirits can be summoned again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_cool: Bloody Bite will be ready in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_no_t: Aim at a living enemy within claw reach to use Bloody Bite.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_requ: Bloody Bite requires an empty main hand.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.overworld_: No alien sky will witness this oath. The Alpha Trial belongs to the Overworld alone.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.night_only: Daylight still covers the land. The trial may only begin once night falls beneath the watching moon.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.already_ac: The trial ward upon this altar is still active; another trial cannot begin simultaneously.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.level_requ: Your blood has not yet fully matured to bear the weight of the Moon-Crown. Return once you reach werewolf level 10.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.form_requi: The trial answers only a challenger in bipedal werewolf form. Set aside human guise, Wildstride, and Beast Form.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.single_pla: The moon-oath acknowledges only a single challenger. Ensure no other players stand within the 18-block ward.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.structure_: The altar formation or offerings are incomplete; the outer Moonbane Pearls fail to resonate with the central badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.begin: The badge lifts from the stone as four Moonbane Pearls rise along silver arcs—the arena seals, and the trial begins!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.hunters_ar: A pale pillar of light pierces the sky! Seven Silver-Oath Watchers enter the ward with drawn steel—prepare for battle!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_arri: The last watcher falls as a thunderous howl shatters the night—the Moon-Crowned Alpha descends! The final duel begins!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_says: %s: “Beneath the pale moon, there is nowhere to hide!”
%s: “Pack, to me! By the authority of the Moon-Crown—tear this usurper limb from limb!”
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_revi: %s: “The Moon-Crown yields to no one!” A defiant roar shakes the ward as moonbane fire rekindles the Alpha's broken frame!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.failed: The trial ends in defeat. The silver arcs dim and the ward shatters; the four Moonbane Pearls burn away into ash, while the Alpha Badge falls beside the central altar, awaiting another challenger.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_fi: The Moon-Crowned Alpha crashes to the earth! The ancient beast stirs in the deepest reaches of your blood—the Moon-Crown is yours! Rewarded with 1 Werewolf Potion, 1 Moonbane Pearl, and 1 Alpha Werewolf Badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_re: The old Alpha falls once more. The rite concludes, returning 1 Moonbane Pearl to your hand.
The apex challenger is vanquished! Hard-won battle sharpens into pure instinct: +1 Skill Point, +1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 Moonbane Pearls.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.owner_h: Ready for orders, my Alpha. Set me to Guard to fight by your side, or right-click me to open my pack.

dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.greet: Good to see you under the moonlight, brother. What's the plan that brought me out here?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.trade: Solid trade, fair and square. Happy hunting out there, brother!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.recru: Swear by the moon, %s: I'm riding with you from here on out, through thick and thin!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.comma: You got it, %s. Ready when you are.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.hunti: By your will, %s. I shall hunt the sun and the moon for you; this road shall not be walked in vain.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.recal: %s, I'm back at your side and ready to roll!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.retur: Awesome hunt this round, %s! Bagged a ton of loot—check it all out!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.reviv: Thanks for pulling me back from the brink, %s! My life is yours, just like always.

dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.guard: Whoever picks a fight with you is my dinner, %s.
Claws are razor sharp, %s. Nobody gets near you.
As long as I'm on my feet, %s, you'll never fight alone.
Got it, %s. I'll hunker down here and keep watch until you call.
Go handle your business, %s. I'll chill under the moonlight and stay on standby.
Holding down this spot, %s. Just whistle and I'm there in a flash.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.inven: Everything in my pack is yours, %s. Take whatever you need.

dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.upgra: The moon just honed my claws and fangs, %s—feeling stronger than ever!
The pearl's power is kicking through my veins, %s. I won't let you down!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.renam: Love the name you gave me, %s. I'll wear it with pride.
Now that's a badass name, %s! That's what they'll call me under the moon.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.reski: New coat, same loyalty, %s. Still got your back.
How's it look, %s? Digging the new fur style?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.comba: Step back, %s! This punk is all mine!
Don't sweat it, %s—we're taking them down together!
Just what I wanted! Watch this, %s—I'm ripping right through their ranks!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.wound: %s, these cuts sting pretty bad, but I'm nowhere near done!
Give me a quick sec to catch my breath, %s—I can still swing!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.victo: Threat neutralized, %s! They're down for the count.
Coast is clear, %s. Let's keep moving forward!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.farew: The night is still young, brother. Time for me to hit the trail.
All settled for today, brother. Give me a shout whenever you need a hand.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.falle: %s... keep your head down... may the moon watch over you...
Sorry, %s... I'm out of juice... keep fighting for both of us...
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.idle_: No matter how long the hike is, %s, I'm sticking with you to the end.
The breeze carries the scent of fresh game far off, %s. Really gets my appetite going.
Rain or shine, day or night, %s, I've got your flank.
Quiet around here for now, %s, but my ears are wide open.
I'm listening to the wind, %s. No sneak attacks happening on my watch.
The pack always protects its own, %s. Take a breather, I'm on it.
Good time to sharpen my claws while we wait, %s. Holler and I'm on my feet.
Pretty cozy spot here, %s. Give the word and we hit the trail.
Quick breather, %s, then we're right back under the moon.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
All five altars must share the exact same height: 1 central altar, with 4 regular altars spaced 3 blocks north, south, east, and west.

Place a Moonbane Pearl in the center and a Wolfsbane on each outer altar, then right-click the center empty-handed. The ritual consumes the 4 flowers, while the pearl remains safely on the altar; if the rite fails or cancels, the flowers are fully refunded.

Your brother will typically jog in from at least 16 blocks away, or teleport straight to the altar if pathing is blocked. Note that the Alpha Trial still requires a badge in the center and pearls on the outer altars.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.m:
Summoned merchants hang around for ten minutes, leaving immediately if their chunk is unloaded. Each merchant randomly draws 8 trades out of a pool of 13 and will not restock.

Buy 1 Werewolf Pelt for 4 Silver Ingots or 4 Wolfsbane. Sell 1 Werewolf Pelt for 2 Silver Ingots or 2 Wolfsbane. Every merchant is guaranteed to offer at least one buy and one sell trade for pelts.

Other offers include Silver Ingots, Wolfsbane, Moonbane Pearls, and both specialty potions. Once recruited with a badge, the merchant transforms into your permanent companion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Once you are a werewolf and have unlocked Pack Oath, right-click a merchant with an Alpha Werewolf Badge and confirm to recruit him. This spends one badge, starting your new companion at Tier 0.

Your companion slot limit scales with Pack Oath: you can carry 1 companion prior to conquering the Alpha Trial; after clearing it, each rank of Pack Oath grants 1 additional slot, up to a maximum of 3.

Every companion holds an active slot, even while out on a hunt or fallen in battle. If you no longer need a companion, choose Dismiss on the Pack tab: after confirmation, he leaves the pack to free up the slot and dumps his inventory back into your hands.

Respecing your skill tree or curing yourself back to human preserves all companion records and gear; excess companions simply rest in standby, automatically reactivating at their old tier once you relearn Pack Oath.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.c:
Follow: sticks right by your side and focuses purely on moving with you. Hostile mobs completely ignore him, and he keeps moving even if attacked; however, stray arrows, explosions, and hazards can still damage him.

Guard: fights alongside you. He assists your attacks, intercepts attackers who strike you, and retaliates against anything that damages him. He will never target creepers, allied players, tamed pets, or PvP-protected players. Switch to Guard whenever venturing into high-danger areas.

Rest: stays put on standby, ready to be recalled at any time. While resting or sorting, mobs ignore him and he will not retaliate if struck.

Companions set to Follow or Guard will automatically teleport across dimensions to rejoin you. Changing orders instantly clears current combat aggro.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.i:
Move within 8 blocks of your companion and hit Inventory on the Pack tab, or simply sneak-right-click the companion to open his pack instantly.

The 9-slot inventory lets you store items on the fly and acts as a loot container for hunting expeditions. Any spoils that exceed the 9-slot limit safely drop onto the ground where he returns.

All items in the pack are completely preserved if the companion falls in combat.

The companion inventory is strictly private and can only be opened by its owner.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.a:
The Appearance tab lets you rename companions and swap coat skins, complete with a live 3D preview on the left: click and drag to rotate, and scroll to zoom. Hit Apply Skin to save your changes.

Models adapt to world settings, with Classic and Modern modes each remembering their own coat setups. Names support up to 32 characters; saving a blank field restores the coat's default name.

The input field in the lower-left corner of the Pack tab customizes how your companions address you (up to 16 characters, saved with world data); click Default to revert to the default title.

All companion chatter is client-side only and visible exclusively to you.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.h:
Sending a companion out to hunt dispatches him for 1.5 to 3 in-game days, delivering rolled loot upon his return. The progress bar on the Pack tab displays real-time trip completion.

Loot yields scale with expedition duration and your companion's rank. Spoils include common Overworld mob drops, raw ores, and wild Wolfsbane flowers.

You can manually recall a companion early at any time, immediately settling rewards based on elapsed time. Every hunt is followed by a mandatory 2-day recovery rest.

Recall commands work across all dimensions, and hunting timers run synced to the world clock.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.u:
Companions start at Tier 0. Upgrading to Tier 1, 2, and 3 requires 2, 4, and 8 Moonbane Pearls respectively, capped by your current Pack Oath skill rank.

Tier 0: Health 30, Attack 6
Tier 1: Health 40, Attack 8, Damage Reduction 10%
Tier 2: Health 50, Attack 10, Damage Reduction 20%
Tier 3: Health 60, Attack 12, Damage Reduction 30%

After staying out of combat for 5 seconds, companions naturally regenerate 1, 1.5, 2, or 2.5 HP per second.

Higher tiers roll significantly more loot drops on hunting expeditions.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
When a companion falls in battle, his name, skin, tier, and backpack items are fully preserved. Spend one Alpha Werewolf Badge on the Pack tab to revive him immediately at full health. Stand in an open area to revive: badges are only consumed upon a successful spawn.

Hunting rest timers continue counting down seamlessly through death and revival.

Press C to open the companion menu (rebindable in Controls); press Esc to close.

Server admins can toggle the entire companion system via gameplay.enableCompanions. Turning it off securely freezes all companion records and gear until re-enabled.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Assign your companion to automatically sort and tidy nearby storage:

1. Move your companion to the middle of your storage room, open the Sorting tab, and hit Start Sorting.
2. All chests and barrels within a 16-block radius (up to the nearest 64 containers) enter the queue, tracked on the radar display.
3. The companion walks over, opens lids, transfers matching items, deposits them into target chests, and closes them up.

Two Sorting Modes:
• Consolidate: gathers identical items into the container that already holds the largest amount.
• Merge Stacks: tops off partial item stacks without rearranging full slots.

Item Frame Filter Trick: attach an item frame holding a sample item to any chest to mark it as dedicated storage. The companion will fetch matching items from other containers and clear out mismatched junk. Matching works by item type regardless of custom names or enchants; multiple frames per chest are supported, while empty frames are ignored as decoration.

Private Storage: companions completely ignore Trapped Chests and Shulker Boxes, making them ideal for personal gear you want left untouched.

Items only merge when item IDs and all components match; non-stackable gear stays in place unless explicitly filtered by a frame. Items only change slots at the moment they are placed, so you can safely stop the job at any point without losing track of gear.

Chests currently in use by players, locked containers, and unopened loot chests are temporarily bypassed and displayed in gray on radar. If pathing to a chest is obstructed, the companion can still sort it remotely from up to 32 blocks away; only containers beyond that range are skipped.

After completing a full pass, the companion idles on site watching for new items; issue any other command to finish the task. Sorting pauses when you log off or change dimensions, resuming automatically when you return.

Server admins can toggle sorting independently using gameplay.enableCompanionSorting.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Companions are loyal werewolf brothers who fight by your side. Bring your first one along in five simple steps:

1. Unlock the Pack Oath skill on the progression screen.
2. Build the altars: place 1 central altar, with regular altars 3 blocks away on each side, all level at the same height.
3. Put 1 Wolfsbane flower on each outer altar and 1 Moonbane Pearl in the center, then right-click the central altar empty-handed.
4. When the wandering merchant arrives, right-click him with an Alpha Werewolf Badge and confirm recruitment.
5. Press C to open the companion menu and issue your first command.

Browse any chapter on the left to learn about detailed mechanics.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.settlements: Hunter Outposts and Werewolf Tribes are scattered across the Overworld. Both factions offer unique barter and supplies, and will openly engage each other in combat. Stay alert for patrols when approaching hunter territory in werewolf form.

Certain villages feature an adjacent watchtower, armory, and training yard. Patrol hunters wield silver swords or Silver-Oath Crossbows whose bolts weaken werewolves. The Moonwarden wears silverhide armor and actively tosses Instant Health II potions to support allies.

Werewolf tribes generate across forests, birch forests, taigas, plains, and savannas. The chief's longhouse, workshops, and Moon-Oath ritual site are built from native materials. Villagers work by day and sleep at night. Bring your offerings to the village altars to launch trials or summon werewolf merchants right on site.

The Moonwarden and the Chief restock their offers at their workstations during the day. Check their trade menus to barter silver ingots, wolfsbane, and werewolf pelts for valuable goods. Local chests and barrels contain food and crafting supplies, and occasionally hold a Moonbane Pearl.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.follo: The wind can blow away tracks, but it can't hide our pack's scent. Right behind you, %s!
Hunting grounds are wide open ahead! Call the shots, %s.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.guard: I've got this perimeter locked down tight. Nothing slips past me, %s—relax.
I'm holding down the fort here, %s. Leave the guard duty to me.
Gonna catch a quick nap here, %s. Eyes closed, but my ears are tracking every leaf that falls.
Fire's nice and warm, %s. Say the word and I'm back on the move.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.comba: I smell blood already! Watch me shred 'em, %s!
Nobody blocks %s's path! You picked the wrong fight!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.wound: Just a flesh wound, no big deal! As long as you're standing with me, %s, I don't back down!
Still got plenty of fight left in me! I'm taking a chunk out of 'em, %s!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.victo: Crushed to dust... Another sweet victory under the moon, %s!
Target down! Scoop up the loot and let's roll to the next spot, %s.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.full_: Man, what a full moon! %s, listen to that howling on the wind—my blood is on fire!
Full moon riding high, everything else went dead quiet... %s, the woods belong to us tonight!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.sunri: Sun's coming up... bright light always stings my wolf eyes a bit, but I'm right beside you, %s.
Heavy downpour washes away our scent and tracks, %s... though soaking wet fur feels like wearing a heavy mop.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.playe: %s! You're bleeding out! Get behind me, I'll take the hits!
Holy smokes, look at that Moon-Crown power! The whole mountain shakes when you step... Hail, my Alpha!
Unstoppable fury and pristine form... It is an honor to hunt at your side, %s!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.biome: Crisp cold breeze and that fresh pine scent... man, this forest feels like home, %s.
Ugh, this sulfur air burns the back of my throat... Watch your step, %s—don't go scorching your paws.
I hear lava bubbling up ahead. Pretty thick haze, %s—let me scout forward a few steps first.
Tracks don't last on this scorched rock. On the way out, %s, we'll just follow that big crack in the wall.
Dead quiet here... feels like the ground's floating over pure void. I'm right behind you, %s.
Not even a sliver of moonlight reaches down here. Lead on, %s—I know your stride anywhere.
Watch your footing, %s. If you take a dive off these cliffs, not even your echo's coming back.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.locat: Mmm, smelling chimney smoke. After all that trekking, finally found a village with actual folks in it, %s.
Villagers up ahead, %s. I'll hang back a pace—you do the talking.
Pretty tight alley here, %s. I'll trail behind so we don't crowd the locals.
That smell is definitely kin. Come on, %s, let's say hi by the fire.
Check that out over there—their Moon-Oath Altar, %s! I've only ever heard stories about it.
Hear that? People talking inside the longhouse. If your feet are killing you, %s, I can ask for a spot to sit down.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.water: Paddling through deep water really slows down the chase, %s... definitely shaking this wet fur out once we hit dry land.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.greeti: Good to meet you under the moon, brother. What kind of gear are you looking to trade for today?
Smelled that bitter wolfsbane bloom across the ridges. Speak up, kin—what supplies do you need?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.stay_n: Trail's waiting, brother. I can only hang around for ten minutes, so check out the wares while you can.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.time_w: Wind's shifting, brother. My packs are strapped tight—got about two minutes before I hit the trail.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.traded: Fair trade, no complaints. Good hunting to you, brother—hope you bag something big!
Solid trade right there. Clean silver and prime wolf pelts don't come easy out in the deep woods.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.idle.0: Trekking these rough ridges year-round, you learn to trust only stout gear and sharp claws.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.idle.1: Watch your back around those guys carrying silver blades... the watchtowers outside the village have been pretty restless lately.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.farewe: Night trail's calling, brother. Catch you further down the road.
Business is done, brother. Next time you're short on supplies, hit up the altar and summon me again.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.hu: Shield that torch, traveler. Whatever's prowling out in the dark has its eyes glued to the village lights.
Sworn by silver. As long as our blades hold an edge, no beast is setting paw past this fence.
Looking for silver weapons to protect yourself, or a bottle of Wolfsbane Potion? Better gear up before the sun goes down.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.in: Hold right there... Your breathing is heavy and there's a wild, feverish gleam in your eyes. Drink a Wolfsbane Potion right now before the moon rises, or you're gonna regret it.
I know the rank smell of a deepwood wolf bite. If you start hearing howling in your head at night... purge the infection while you still have your own mind!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.hu: Silver thread woven straight into wolfskin... stout, weatherproof gear. Looks like your hunts out in the wild actually paid off.
Silverhide keeps out the freezing wind and takes the bite right out of claws. You've taken pretty good care of that armor.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.trade.op: These supplies and draughts were drawn straight from the watchtower armory. Pick out whatever fits your job.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.trade.do: Fair deal, all settled. Take your supplies, and may the silver keep you safe on the road home.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.combat.s: Hostiles incoming! They're breaching the perimeter—draw your steel! Give 'em cold silver!
Back off, beasts! As long as our tower banner flies, this village isn't falling to anyone!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.combat.h: Healing potion out! Hold the line, sworn guards, push forward with me!
Moon's shining way too eerie tonight... Crank the watchtower crossbows to full draw! Patrols in pairs, and stay sharp—nobody sleeps on watch!
Breeze is kicking up damp rot from the leaves... and that nasty stench of wet wolf fur.
You can scan the entire treeline right from the watchtower. As long as that beacon lantern is lit, anything sneaking across the border gets spotted immediately.
Armory just tuned up a fresh batch of Silver-Oath Crossbows. Keep the latches wiped clean. When a feral werewolf rushes you, that first shot makes all the difference.
Silverhide flexes just like soft leather, but it shrugs off frostbite and wolf claws. Put on a piece and you'll move a whole lot lighter on your feet.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.hum: Soft little two-legged mortal... don't rub that harvest-chaff smell onto our tribal totems. If you want to walk out of here in one piece, watch your tongue.
The tribe is always open for fair barter. Brought silver or wild herbs? Check out the trade list. And if you've got real guts, drink a Werewolf Potion and prove your mettle.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.wer: I can smell the cold wild woods on you... Good to see you, kin. The moon's shining bright; has your pack tasted warm prey tonight?
Bones and fangs are the only real law under these stars. Spend time running the deep timber; don't let soft human hearths dull your edge.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.alp: That sheer presence from the Moon-Crown... even the high peaks bow down before you. Hail, Alpha of the pack—our entire tribe answers to your call.
Such raw, dominant beast power... even my old bones feel the thrill. You wear the true crown of the wild!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.qua: What a sleek, powerful quadruped runner! Go run wild and kick up the dust—these old woods are your personal playground.
You don't truly realize how massive the wild is until you run on all four paws. Go on, kin—the wind and fresh game are waiting out there for you.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.trade.ope: Take a look at the tribe's fresh game and herbs. We trade for silver ingots, wolfsbane, and werewolf pelts.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.trade.don: Fair barter, good and clean. Keep that wild blood sharp, and stay ferocious when the next full moon comes around.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.de: Pack! Bare your fangs and claws! Tear apart every arrogant fool who dares step onto our tribe's grounds!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.he: Catch the healing potion! On your feet, kin! Our wolf blood is still running hot—push in and shred them with me!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.ambient.f: Listen to that... the howling on the night wind. The Moon-Mother is calling her children—tonight, this whole forest belongs to us!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.ambient.i: Campfire smoke keeps off the bugs, but nothing calms that restless hunger boiling in our blood.
The Moon-Oath Altars in our tribe have stood here for generations. Step closer—hear that low hum down in the rock? The wild is calling out for a true Alpha.
We use wolfsbane for the trials and Moonbane Pearls to call our kin. No matter how far a lone wolf roams, the Moon-Oath always points the way home.
Hunters put all their trust in watchtowers and crossbow bolts, while we honor the Moon-Oath our ancestors swore at the altar. Iron rusts away, but the Moon-Mother's fangs never dull.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.de: Kin, get behind me! Pack, flank those hunters and close the circle!
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.settlements: With cheat commands enabled, use /locate structure #howlingwerewolf:werewolf_tribes to pinpoint the nearest werewolf tribe, or /locate structure howlingwerewolf:hunter_watchtower to locate a hunter watchtower.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.poun: Unlocking Feral Leap costs 3 Skill Points. Press Z to target a landing zone, left-click to leap, and right-click to cancel. The maximum leap ranges are 25 blocks in bipedal form, 30 blocks in quadruped form, and 27 blocks in Beast Form. All forms share a 15-second cooldown and grant Speed I for 5 seconds upon landing.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.ambient.i: The pups always ask why I don't care for cooked meat. Hah—that warm splash of fresh blood right when you tear through the hide? That's the best flavor in the wild, and fire just ruins it.
Those tin-can hunters actually think stone walls keep them safe. Wait until a blizzard blocks off the pass and they can't even catch a rat—they'll learn fangs beat iron any day.
Back when I was young, I'd chase the fastest stag until its lungs gave out. Now that I'm older, I'd rather stand on the ridge, catch the breeze, and smell which peak just had a fresh litter of pups.
Never get sloppy cleaning silver. Even a speck of grease on the blade takes the bite right out of the purge. Cut corners, and you're the one ending up in a ditch.

Don't panic if you hear distant howling—that just means they're still miles out. It's when the woods go dead quiet without a single bird chirp... that's when you nock an arrow. They're right on top of you.

Two rookies almost wet themselves over a wolf roar last night. Told 'em fear is fine—keeps your hands steady on the crossbow. As long as the village lanterns are still burning come sunrise, our watch did its job.
